QuestInfo.name: Preparing for Rock-Paper-Scissors
QuestInfo.0: You need to make preparations to play Rock-Paper-Scissors with Gaga. Ask him what you should do.
QuestInfo.1: Collect 20 Rock Cards, 20 Paper Cards, and 20 Scissors Cards as Gaga asked.
QuestInfo.2: You've got all the cards Gaga asked you to bring. Now you can play!

0.0: Before playing Rock-Paper-Scissors with me, you need the right playing pieces. You'll have to collect 20 Rock Cards, 20 Paper Cards, and 20 Scissors Cards to be able to put up a fight. You can get them, right?

yes.0: All monsters drop these cards, so it shouldn't be a problem getting them. I don't know why monsters have them...they're not smart enough to play.

no.0: Look, if you don't have the cards for the game, we can't play the game. Any real Rock-Paper-Scissors Master would want to get their own cards, anyway...
